# ATVM Interface

> A simulation of the Automatic Ticket Vending Machine (ATVM) interface
> found at railway stations, designed with Human-Machine Interaction (HMI)
> principles.

Author: Amey Thakur, ORCID 0000-0001-5644-1575
Co-author: Mega Satish, ORCID 0000-0002-1844-9557
